ITEM 1 | Stainless steel mixing bowl, about 22 cm across, holding the food; not food, contributes no weight | 0
ITEM 2 | Thinly sliced purple-red onion rings and half-rings, translucent edges with bright magenta-violet skin, scattered across the top and sides, moist and slightly glossy, holding their curved shape, roughly 3-5 cm long pieces | 45
ITEM 3 | Diced green bell pepper pieces, about 1-2 cm, bright green with pale translucent edges, matte-to-slightly glossy, firm and crisp-looking, scattered in the lower left and right areas | 40
ITEM 4 | Cooked chicken pieces, cubed or shredded, about 1-2 cm, off-white to pale tan with light golden edges, slightly dry-looking surface with fibrous texture, clustered in the upper right and upper center of the bowl | 50
ITEM 5 | Julienned carrot strips, about 3-5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, bright orange, matte, firm, mixed among the onions and peppers | 20
ITEM 6 | Whole cherry tomato, about 2.5 cm diameter, glossy deep red with slight sheen, smooth skin, sitting near the top center among the chicken and carrot | 12
